title: Price Change Synchronization
scenario: Find pairs of products that changed prices on the exact same dates at least 3 times.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Self-join on date and group by product pairs.
correctQuery: SELECT a.product_id AS product_1, b.product_id AS product_2 FROM products a JOIN products b ON a.change_date = b.change_date AND a.product_id < b.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
